Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Number ten, Foltyn, with “Roblox cheat during test..”. Over one point five million views. It also has over two thousand comments.
Coming in at number nine, Allan’s Life, with “You Can't See People Until They Say Hello”. Over five point nine million views. It got there in just two days. It also has over one thousand comments.
